# desflow

> Realistic event streams from a SimPy simulation you can steer while it runs, written to Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Parquet, JSONL and Iceberg.

## Home

- [Home](https://jaehyeon.me/desflow/latest/index.md)

## Installation

- [Installation](https://jaehyeon.me/desflow/latest/getting-started/index.md)
